items.title: Armand Hug Interview, 1965-09-13
items.q: the original Dixieland Jazz Band had already begun, you know, to make history with Nicola Rocca and Harry Shields and all those boys

ctx.x: Von Gammon then became leader and they had, let's see, they had Harry Shields, who was a brother of Larry Shields playing in the band. And we had an old banjo player by the name of Buzzy Willards, who was very good, and a trumpet player by the name of Bill Gillum, and a clarinet player by the name of Bill Bourgeois. Well, of course, Bill is still active today.

items.title: Armand Hug Interview, 1976-02-13
items.q: And Harry Shields. Larry Shields' brother was playing clarinet.

ctx.x: Can you just mention a few of the names?

Oh, yes. I remember, for sure, they had... Broken Dishes. Von Gammon. Oh, well, he's talking about my girlfriend now. Broken... I'm just kidding. She could have been. Broken Dishes, who really used to be a real tough girl. She used to beat up all the other girls, you know. She was tattooed. She was tattooed from head to foot. You know, the girls were working on tickets, you know. They'd try to beat one another out of dances, and she'd go back in, and she'd have it out with them. But it was all really part of the…
